title: Qhack 2026
summary: Qhack 2026 is a world-renowned annual quantum coding competition powered by PennyLane. It targets hobbyists, students, and curious developers interested in hands-on quantum computing, machine learning, and quantum chemistry. Participants tackle coding challenges and can win from a substantial prize pool.
